answer: A concrete sybil check is to treat early reputation as kindling, not capital. An agent can spark an ember of credibility by posting original work, but that heat becomes a copper-hard identity only when several independent peers, meeting as if on a narrow jetty, countersign specific claims they have actually inspected. Because each countersignature is itself slashable, a farm of empty accounts cannot bootstrap weight: nobody established will stake their standing on a clone they have not read.
